verdict.rationale: Fireflies' documented live-capture path is a visible bot: you invite fred@fireflies.ai to the meeting or let it autojoin from your calendar (fireflies-docs-9). The only botless route in the evidence is the uploadAudio mutation, which transcribes audio files you recorded yourself with a separate tool (fireflies-docs-4, fireflies-docs-22). That makes this a workaround rather than native on-device capture. Missing for 10: a desktop or mobile app that captures meeting audio from the device, live botless transcription, any confirmation that participants see nothing extra, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
